3. k_sl_3a_d_r2: verbs add use, override, activate, operate. 

Do NOT add lead, guide, take, open or follow-the-route phrases to any 3A reveal: 'Lead the freed captives through the narrow corridor.', 'Open the detention cells.' and 'Take the stolen radio.' must fire nothing.
